520:t_2:305.en:
$$シャア$$
「I won't let you touch $$ミネバ$$!」

520:t_2:306.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$アンジェロ$$! I'll leave them to you!」

520:t_2:307.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Open your eyes already, $$フロンタル$$! $$アンジェロ$$ himself is proof that you're different from $$シャア$$!」

520:t_2:309.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You and $$シャア$$... $$アンジェロ$$ and $$ギュネイ$$... There's a huge difference there.」

520:t_2:310.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ followed in $$シャア$$'s footsteps so he could surpass him one day.」

520:t_2:311.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「How pitiful he is, even his own protege rebelling against him.」

520:t_2:312.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not it. It's the result of $$シャア$$ showing $$ギュネイ$$ a future!」

520:t_2:314.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But you, $$フロンタル$$! All you did was affirm $$アンジェロ$$!」

520:t_2:315.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You gave $$アンジェロ$$ the present, but that won't help him grow! He'll forever be a man who serves beneath you!」

520:t_2:316.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What's wrong with that!? I'm prepared to devote everything to the Colonel!」

520:t_2:317.en:
$$シャア$$
「Admit it, $$アンジェロ$$! Without $$フロンタル$$, you can't do anything!」

520:t_2:318.en:
$$シャア$$
「You're just $$フロンタル$$'s pet!」

520:t_2:319.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You keep running your mouths...!」

520:t_2:320.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Humanity gained the power of fire and built civilization. ...But the first person to touch fire must have trembled at its heat...」

520:t_2:321.en:
$$アムロ$$
「By overcoming that, humanity gained evolution... a future!」

520:t_2:322.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If all you do is preserve the present, you can't advance any further!」

520:t_2:324.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I want every $$ネオ・ジオン$$ soldier here to listen.」

520:t_2:325.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Whatever $$ラプラスの箱$$ may be, it will bring a great turning point for $$ジオン$$. Humanity may survive through $$フロンタル$$'s methods.」

520:t_2:326.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That is probably correct. In our present situation, it may be the only realistic answer.」

520:t_2:327.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But can that truly be called a future? Doesn't 'future' mean a time different from now... a better world?」

520:t_2:328.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「There is none of the human evolution and harmony that $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ dreamed of in it.」

520:t_2:330.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「As heirs to the name of $$ジオン$$, and as those who caused the devastation of the $$一年戦争$$, we have a responsibility.」

520:t_2:331.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「We can't fulfill it by simply accepting reality as it is.」

520:t_2:332.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「How can the surviving heir of the $$ザビ家$$ say that!?」

520:t_2:333.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Princess! I'll hold them off here! Please fall back while you can!」

520:t_2:334.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Stop, $$マリーダ$$! Come here with the Princess!」

520:t_2:336.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ジンネマン$$! Are you still trapped in the past!?」

520:t_2:338.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Don't make $$マリーダ$$ suffer! You must fulfill your responsibility, too!」

520:t_2:339.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Remember, $$ジンネマン$$! Ever since you saved $$マリーダ$$, you...」

520:t_2:340.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Logic... can't erase my hatred... or my regrets...」

520:t_2:341.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I couldn't... do anything for them... They must have been scared... They must have suffered... I did nothing... $$フィー$$... $$マリィ$$...」

520:t_2:343.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$... Will you...」

520:t_2:344.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Will you... forgive my selfishness...?」

520:t_2:353.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I forgive you. This is my last order...」

520:t_2:360.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ジンネマン$$, you bastard!」

520:t_2:361.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Do it if you want. I can no longer... stay with you.」

520:t_2:362.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You're always like this! You're irresponsible and weak!」

520:t_2:363.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's why we need power beyond humanity! The Colonel has surpassed humanity!」

520:t_2:366.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let the Captain die!」

520:t_2:367.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Ghh! $$バナージ・リンクス$$!!」

520:t_2:368.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Humanity's future... is something humans create!」

520:t_2:369.en:
$$バナージ$$
「People are weak and imperfect...! That's why we entrust our hopes to others!」

520:t_2:370.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We keep walking with those hopes entrusted to us, no matter how painful the path!」

520:t_2:371.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The $$ユニコーン$$ activated!?」

520:t_2:372.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ reacting to $$バナージ$$'s feelings!?」

520:t_2:373.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We're falling back, $$アンジェロ$$.」

520:t_2:375.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Ghh! Damn you, $$シャア$$!」

520:t_2:376.en:
$$シャア$$
「You hit me back! It seems you haven't completely become a vessel yet!」

520:t_2:377.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Are you provoking me, $$シャア$$!?」

520:t_2:378.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I'll take you on! Get in the $$サザビー$$!」

520:t_2:379.en:
$$シャア$$
「I accept! I'll settle things between us right here!」

520:t_3:3.en: ～Deep-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$　Dock～

520:t_3:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm sorry you had to see me in such an unseemly state, Lady $$ミネバ$$.」

520:t_3:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「No... Your expression is brighter now than I've ever seen it.」

520:t_3:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'm the one who should thank you, $$ハマーン$$, for protecting me until today and fighting for $$ジオン$$... for $$スペースノイド$$s.」

520:t_3:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But from now on, fight for what you believe in, rather than a great cause or the family you were born into.」

520:t_3:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That will probably be the same goal you're striving for.」
